paragraphs: Zone & Co’s mission to embed AI directly into Oracle NetSuite mirrors my recent work deploying an agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda, where I orchestrated ECR image pipelines, IAM execution roles and least‑privilege policies to ensure secure, scalable operation.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, leveraging FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client.
I have not used Azure yet, but I am eager to bring my cloud‑native deployment experience to your platform.
Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how my Lambda‑based deployment strategy could be adapted to Oracle NetSuite’s ERP‑native AI environment?
